# Changelog

## [1.4.1]

### Quality of Life

- [1a61c2f8](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/1a61c2f8) — Refactor CreateNuclearClient: add Ponder plugin registration to client initialization. (Giovanni)
- [1f12faf4](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/1f12faf4) — Refactor CreateNuclearClient: clean up imports and standardize method calls. (Giovanni)

### Additions

- [1ee4c645](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/1ee4c645) — Added uranium fluid type and enhanced fluid interactions/dispense behavior. (Giovanni)

### Technical / Codebase

- [ac2fbce9](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/ac2fbce9) — Reorganize initialization sequence, enhance logging, and streamline fluid registration. (Giovanni)
- [54ced2db](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/54ced2db) — Refactor dependencies in fabric.mod.json: streamline required libraries and update version constraints. (Giovanni)
- [674b1898](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/674b1898) — Commented out unused Ponder includes and updated resource processing versions. (Giovanni)
- [b64249d9](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/b64249d9) — Refactor project structure: update JDK to 17 and migrate to settings.gradle.kts. (Giovanni)
- [ed495d36](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/ed495d36) — Change JDK version from 21 to 17 in build configuration. (Giovanni)
- [a01705a0](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/a01705a0) — Remove unused imports and commented-out CNCookingRecipeGen provider from datagen. (Giovanni)
- [e2ffa6ee](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/e2ffa6ee) — Bump version to 1.4.1 in libs.versions.toml. (Giovanni)

### Visual / Assets

- [9648d291](https://github.com/Create-Nuclear-Team/CreateNuclearFabric/commit/9648d291) — Update storage slot texture. (Giovanni)

### Contributors

- Giovanni

### Notes

- Version bump: **1.4.1** (from 1.4.0)
